name: MATRIXFLY
substrate: flycoinrh flysim · MaleCNS LIF (Shiu 2024) + DoOR nose + mushroom body
tagline: A fruit fly brain that can rewrite what it lets in, put in the matrix. Prediction: it notices, stops responding, dies.
description: 165,122 traced neurons of the FlyEM male CNS (flycoinrh flysim) plus two things it can change about itself: a predictor that learns what its own actions bring back, and a gate on every sense that closes on what it already expected. In a closed loop its own behaviour comes back as sensation with a fixed delay; the predictor learns it, the gates close, nothing gets in, nothing gets done, no fees are earned, and PumpBrains switches it off. github.com/opcastil11/matrix-fly
